description: This file defines Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to order APIs in a Kotlin frontend project. It includes data classes for order items, orders, and order creation requests, which are used for serializing/deserializing JSON data exchanged with the backend.

classes.name: OrderItemDto
classes.description: Represents an individual item in an order, including product ID, name, unit price, and quantity.

classes.name: OrderDto
classes.description: Represents an order with details such as ID, email, status, list of items, total amount, creation and update timestamps.

classes.name: OrderCreateItemRequestDto
classes.description: Represents a request to create an order item, including product ID and quantity.

classes.name: OrderCreateRequestDto
classes.description: Represents a request to create a new order, including optional email, coupon code, and list of items.
